description: Roster: prepare (unsigned) enroll (list one of your characters so get_roster shows it), fill (put an enrolled character in a seat of your next squad for a game and ref; replaces your earlier seat with the same role) or clear (empty your seats for a game and ref). Costs nothing but gas.

collection.description: For enroll and fill: the character collection (0x).

game.description: For fill and clear: the game contract address (0x) the squad is for.

ref.description: For fill and clear: the game's job / race / hit id.

role.description: For fill: the squad role the character fills.

wallet.description: Your own 0x wallet address. Nothing is sent from it; it is used to read your balance and allowance and to simulate.

name: prepare_roster
